component-o.description-s: 0.96 in 128 x 64 monochrome OLED module, I2C (0x3C), SSD1306 or SH1106 controller (maker does not say which), 27 x 28 mm PCB, 4-pin 2.54 mm header GND-VCC-SCL-SDA

non-technical-o.stock-note-s: DigiKey 3647-26095-ND, 20 in stock (pcbparts digikey_get_part 2026-10-21) -- thin stock; the module class is generic (many clones with the same 27 x 27 mm board and pinout)

component-o.footprint_check-s: board footprint DISPLAY:OLED 0.91: 4 pads at 2.54 mm pitch along the top edge (y -12.75), silkscreen outline 27.5 x 27.5 mm, nets pad1 GND, pad2 VCC, pad3 SCL, pad4 SDA; the maker's photo (p1) shows header silk 'GND VCC SCL SDA' and states PCB 27 x 28 mm -- matches

module_source-o.table-s: Power consumption: <40mW; PCB size 27 x 28 mm; I2C address 0x3C (typically)

controller-o.part-s: SSD1306 (or SH1106 -- undisclosed by the module maker)

source-o.table-s: Table 12-1 DC Characteristics (IDD/ICC at VDD 2.8 V, VCC 12 V, display ON all pixels, no panel loading)

chargepump_source-o.table-s: charge-pump application note: VDD 1.65-3.3 V (< VBAT), VBAT 3.3-4.2 V

source-o.table-s: Power consumption <40mW (the module's only supply figure)

not_stated-o.vmin_mv: module input range not stated in the maker datasheet (DigiKey's listing text says 3.3-5 V, not in the PDF)
not_stated-o.vmax_mv: not stated in the module datasheet
not_stated-o.i_max_ma: not stated; only power < 40 mW (at an unstated voltage)
not_stated-o.on_board_regulator: the module's regulator / charge-pump arrangement is not documented; SSD1306's own charge pump needs VBAT >= 3.3 V (p62), above a CR2032's 3.0 V nominal -- whether the module works from 3.0 V is not stated
not_stated-o.controller: maker says SSD1306 OR SH1106; controller figures above are SSD1306's (Solomon Systech Rev 1.1)
